verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents physical storage windows: up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages. It also includes secure shredding and lets you forward physical items, so there is a basic set of disposal options. However, nothing shows that shredding happens on request or comes with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices are only implied. Missing for 10: on-request shredding workflow, shred confirmation/certificate, explicit per-item disposal controls (shred/forward/hold/recycle), independent or hands-on corroboration.
